title: Runewatch quest chain
description: Authored quest encounters. An opponent is named by its bestiary id and never restates its stats: those live once in data/enemies.csv and are scaled per encounter by a threat rating. Loaded by src/game/quests.ts.

bestiary.description: The bestiary in data/ this file's opponents come from, e.g. 'the-long-dark.enemies.csv'. Defaults to 'enemies.csv'.

acts.description: Chapter metadata, mirroring the design doc's 'acts at a glance'. Optional, and only present once the chain itself is authored; a quest's `act` must name one of these ids.

materials.description: Core material id (see tagCoreId in src/game/formulas.ts) to quantity. Cores only: quests.test.ts asserts every id comes from allCoreIds().

cardId.description: Bestiary id in data/enemies.csv. It supplies the base stats, the display name and the art.

count.description: How many identical copies stand in the encounter (the design doc's '2x'). All copies share one stat line.

elite.description: Authoring flag for the design doc's '*(elite)*' marker. The loader ignores it; it marks the monsters meant to be tougher, which the balance pass turns into a `threat`.

threat.description: Multiplies this line's bestiary stats, for the rare encounter that wants to sit off the row. Omitted in almost every line: a monster's numbers come from the bestiary.

name.description: Presentation override for the enemy line; defaults to the bestiary's name.

act.description: Id of an entry in `acts`. Omitted for a quest that is not part of a numbered act (the starter quests).

boss.description: Authoring flag for the act-finale quests. Presentation only.

power.description: Advisory recommended power, shown on the quest card. The server never gates a clear on it.

hook.description: The design doc's one-line Hook: the seed the `intro` grows from. Narrative only — nothing reads it at runtime.

enemies.description: Authored enemy LINES, not combatants: `count` is expanded by the loader, so the expanded roster must still be 1..5 (asserted by quests.test.ts).

reward.description: Repeating reward, paid on every clear.

firstClear.description: One-time bonus, paid only on the first clear (`first_cleared_at` is never rewritten, so it cannot be farmed).

intro.description: The visual-novel beats before the fight. Optional while a quest's script is still a Hook line in the design doc.

outro.description: The visual-novel beats after a win. Optional for the same reason as `intro`.
